description: Look up one Chinese word or character, written in simplified or traditional characters. Returns its pinyin, every meaning, its HSK level, other readings of the same characters, each character it is made of, and the GraphChinese lessons that teach it. Use this when the user asks what a specific Chinese word means or how it is pronounced. Do not use it for Japanese or other languages.

word.description: The word in Chinese characters, for example 便宜.

name: lookup_word
title: Look up a Chinese word
